4896 Stagecoach Rd
Montezuma, IA
Map to Event
October 22, 2026
1:00 pm · 3:30pm
Crafternoons programs are for adults. Try your hand at a new skill using natural, recycled, or minimal materials.
Create your own birdhouse gourd. Gourds are dried and ready to turn into the birdhouse of your dreams! All supplies will be provided. Wear old clothes and come ready to be creative!
RSVP required! We have limited space for this event. This helps ensure we have enough supplies for everyone! Email Amy at adurbin@poweshiekcountyiowa.gov or call 319-213-5607 during business hours.

Nature Explorers
Montezuma, IA
October 27, 2026
10:00 am
Nature Explorers is a free program with content aimed at preschoolers through 5th graders - though learners of all ages are always welcome! In the school year we meet every other Tuesday at Diamond Lake's Main Shelter (weather permitting). Lessons usually feature a story, discussion of science or nature topic and an activity or craft. The same program will be offered at 10 am and 1 pm, come to whichever works for your family's schedule.
Amy will send out a text reminder and any pertininent information for the next day's program on Monday. For example "We plan to take a short walk, please bring winter layers" or "We'll be doing watercolors please wear old clothes!"
RSVPs are not required, but they are always appreciated!
Email Amy at adurbin@poweshiekcountyiowa.gov or text 319-213-5607 to get on the Monday text list.

About Poweshiek County
Located in east-central Iowa, Poweshiek County was established in 1843 and named for Meskwaki Chief Poweshiek, a chief of the Fox Indian people. The Courthouse, located in Montezuma, was completed in 1859. The County is home to eight communities and home to 18,662 residents.
The County is administered by a three-member Board of Supervisors who are elected for four-year terms. Other elected officials include the Attorney , Auditor , Recorder , Sheriff , and Treasurer .
